crossRefs.note: For ask now of the days that are past, which were before you, since the day that God created man on the earth, and from…
you shall not be afraid of them. You shall remember well what Yahweh your God did to Pharaoh and to all Egypt:
the great trials which your eyes saw, the signs, the wonders, the mighty hand, and the outstretched arm, by which…
“You saw the affliction of our fathers in Egypt, and heard their cry by the Red Sea,

translations.web: the great trials which your eyes saw, the signs, and those great wonders.
translations.bsb: You saw with your own eyes the great trials, and those miraculous signs and wonders.
translations.kjv: The great temptations which thine eyes have seen, the signs, and those great miracles:
translations.asv: the great trials which thine eyes saw, the signs, and those great wonders:
